summary: Bug-fix VERIFIED: GEMINI_MODEL upgrade from 'gemini-2.5-flash' -> 'gemini-3.5-flash' resolves the 404 NOT_FOUND / 'no longer available to new users' error. Created targeted test suite /app/backend/tests/test_gemini_model_fix.py with 9 tests covering (1) constant assertion, (2) 4 AI endpoints with a bogus x-gemini-api-key -> all return HTTP 400 with 'INVALID_ARGUMENT' + reason 'API_KEY_INVALID' (proving the request now reaches Google with a valid model name and fails on the key, not the model), (3) 4 missing-key regression checks -> all return HTTP 401 with detail 'Missing Google Gemini API key. Set it in Settings.'. Full regression suite (test_vocash_backend.py + test_ledgr_new_features.py + test_gemini_model_fix.py) = 48/48 PASSED. No regressions in CRUD, reports, or backup endpoints. Live curl against POST /api/settings/test-key with bogus key confirms Google response payload: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, reason=API_KEY_INVALID, service=generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

minor.issue: Backend wraps Gemini SDK exceptions with 'except Exception -> HTTPException(400, str(e))'. This surfaces auth-model-quota-network failures all as 400. A 401 for API_KEY_INVALID and 429 for RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED would be more semantically correct, but this does not affect the current bug fix.

action_items: (Optional) Map specific Gemini error codes to specific HTTP statuses: API_KEY_INVALID -> 401, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED -> 429, PERMISSION_DENIED -> 403.
(Optional) Add a small model-availability probe at app startup that logs a warning if GEMINI_MODEL is deprecated, so future Google deprecations are caught before user-facing failures.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified against live Google API. Live evidence from curl on /api/settings/test-key with bogus key: '{"detail":"Gemini test failed: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. {\'error\': {\'code\': 400, \'message\': \'API key not valid...\', \'status\': \'INVALID_ARGUMENT\', ..., \'reason\': \'API_KEY_INVALID\', ...}}"}'. The chain is now: bogus key -> reaches Google -> Google validates model 'gemini-3.5-flash' OK -> Google rejects key with API_KEY_INVALID -> backend wraps as 400. Any future 'no longer available to new users' error would indicate the model was deprecated again and GEMINI_MODEL in /app/backend/server.py line 33 needs another bump. Full suite: 48/48 (30 vocash + 9 ledgr features + 9 gemini fix).
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Google deprecated the 'gemini-2.5-flash' model and started returning 404 NOT_FOUND with message 'model models/gemini-2.5-flash is no longer available to new users' for calls from newer API keys. Because GEMINI_MODEL was hard-coded to 'gemini-2.5-flash' and used across 4 endpoints (test-key, parse-command, ocr-receipt, transcribe), every AI feature broke simultaneously. REPRODUCTION (pre-fix): curl -X POST /api/settings/test-key with any valid or invalid key -> 400 with 'Gemini test failed: 404 NOT_FOUND ... no longer available'. MITIGATION: single-line change /app/backend/server.py:33 -> GEMINI_MODEL = 'gemini-3.5-flash'. VERIFICATION: curl now returns 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT / API_KEY_INVALID with a bogus key, confirming the model resolves successfully and only the key is being rejected.
